_doc: Overrides for onboarding-site/src/stops.py and onboarding-site/src/nap.py, by the name of a folder of the cache (GTFS_CACHE, default ~/.cache/guest-guides/gtfs-es/): every folder holding a zip is read; this gives a folder its own words {id, name, credit, licence, url, link (where a guest finds timetables)}, any of them, over what its meta.json says, or leaves it out ({skip: true}, with _why: nap.py does not fetch it, stops.py does not read it). A folder with a meta.json (the national access point's files) is credited to its organisation, "Powered by MITRAMS".
